description: QA-only supported rendered recipe. Run phase4 scenario first on task-owned3321; synthetic probes removed in finally. Never user records.

steps.fn:
async()=>{if(location.origin!=='http://127.0.0.1:3321'||JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('launchpad.business-profile.v1')).name!=='QA Glass Studio')throw Error('QA origin required');const before=JSON.stringify({...localStorage});const f=document.querySelector('.crm-contacts form');if(!f||!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Unsaved edit recovery"]'))throw Error('Run phase4 conflict recipe first');const box=document.createElement('div');box.dataset.qaRecovery='true';const add=(html)=>box.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);add('
');for(const wrapper of ['hidden','inert','aria-hidden="true"','style="display:none"','style="visibility:hidden"','style="opacity:0"','style="content-visibility:hidden"'])add('
');for(const type of ['password','hidden','file'])add('');add('');f.append(box);box.querySelector('textarea').value='line1\n';const review=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Review unsaved form copy').click();const read=()=>JSON.parse(document.querySelector('[aria-label="Unsaved edit recovery"] textarea').value);try{review();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);const snapshot=read();if(JSON.stringify(snapshot).includes('PRIVATE'))throw Error('Private control copied');const fields=snapshot.fields;if(fields.some(x=>x.label==='QA secret'))throw Error('Password/file/type-hidden copied');const get=l=>fields.find(x=>x.label===l);if(get('QA legend')?.value!=='legend allowed')throw Error('First legend semantics lost');if(get('QA choices')?.selection.length!==2||get('QA choices').selection[1].label!=='Beta'||get('QA choices').label.includes('Alpha'))throw Error('Select fidelity');if(get('QA radio')?.value!=='option-a'||get('QA radio').checked!==true||get('QA checkbox')?.checked!==true||get('QA prose')?.value!=='line1\n')throw Error('Field fidelity');box.querySelector('textarea').value='refreshed';if(read().fields.find(x=>x.label==='QA prose').value==='refreshed')throw Error('Not snapshot');review();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);if(read().fields.find(x=>x.label==='QA prose').value!=='refreshed')throw Error('Refresh failed');if(before!==JSON.stringify({...localStorage}))throw Error('Storage mutated');return {privacy:true,firstLegend:true,multiSelect:true,radioCheckbox:true,plainText:true,snapshotRefresh:true,storageUnchanged:true};}finally{box.remove();review();}}
